_comment: New Chronicle content: a quest-giver and a quest for each realm beyond the Mistwood, two new quest items and where they can be found. Merged into the original GameData content by Spice Trip > Rebuild Project.

items.name: Grave Token
items.desc: A clay token pressed with a name. The shades of the Hollow Reach cannot rest until someone speaks it.

items.name: Star Ember
items.desc: A coal of fallen starlight from the Threshold. Warm, and humming with a god's half-remembered dream.

npcs.name: Nerissa, Keeper of the Tide
npcs.greeting: Mind the water, Unmarked. It remembers every footstep.
lines: This temple was raised to the Deep Sovereign, but the bronze guardians Pyrrhon left here have forgotten which god they serve. They strike at anything that moves.
Break three of the Bronze Watchers and the tide will settle. Thalassar does not forget a kindness.

npcs.name: Damon the Last Watchman
npcs.greeting: Another living face. It has been a long time.
lines: When the city fell, every family pressed its names into clay tokens. The shades still wander looking for them.
Find five Grave Tokens among the ruins and bring them to me. I will read the names aloud, and the shades will finally sleep.

npcs.name: Ione the Lampbearer
npcs.greeting: Keep close to my lamp. The dark down here has teeth.
lines: The Hollow Hounds hunt in packs where the tunnels narrow. While they prowl, no lamp in the Underway stays lit for long.
Thin the pack by four and I can light the old path down toward the Veiled Queen's gate.

npcs.name: Captain Aster
npcs.greeting: Halt. No, wait. You carry a god's light. Pass.
lines: My guard is three soldiers and a dog, and the Strix have taken the towers. They scream omens all night long.
Bring down four of them, Unmarked, and the Pale Citadel will open its gates to you.

npcs.name: The Herald of the Theurgoi
npcs.greeting: So the prophecy walks on its own feet at last.
lines: The Theurgoi dream, and their dreams fall here as embers of starlight.
Gather three Star Embers and bring them to me. With them I can wake the Stormcrown long enough for him to claim you.

quests.title: The Drowned Watch
quests.summary: Nerissa asks you to break three of the Bronze Watchers that stalk the Drowned Temple.
quests.lore: Bronze does not tire and does not forget its orders. It only rusts, and the sea is patient.

quests.title: Names of the Fallen
quests.summary: Damon needs five Grave Tokens from the Hollow Reach so the city's shades can be named and put to rest.
quests.lore: A shade without a name walks forever. Speak its name and it can finally lie down.

quests.title: Light in the Underway
quests.summary: Ione can light the old path once four Hollow Hounds are dealt with.
quests.lore: The hounds are hollow where their hearts should be. Light frightens them, and that is how they lose.

quests.title: The Pale Watch
quests.summary: Captain Aster wants four Strix brought down from the Pale Citadel's towers.
quests.lore: A strix's cry is an omen. Four fewer cries, four fewer omens.

quests.title: The Last Rite
quests.summary: The Herald needs three Star Embers to wake the Stormcrown, so a god can finally claim you.
quests.lore: Every prophecy ends somewhere. This one ends at the Threshold, with starlight in your hands.

objectives.text: Bring the embers to the Herald
